endorsements.quote: Hence, it is imperative for nursing professionals to undergo comprehensive training and education to proficiently employ AI tools and judiciously leverage the chronic disease data provided by big data resources.

unlisted_practices: Involve nurses in the development phase of AI tools for chronic disease care, not only as users and feedback providers.
Understand the operational principles of AI before implementation and avoid indiscriminately replacing all tasks with AI.
Use structured development and standardized evaluation processes to improve the comparability and quality of chronic-condition chatbots.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article examining the role of nurses in chronic disease management alongside AI, discussing developmental challenges and future directions rather than presenting original empirical data.
